EventHandler.Name: DeptChanged
EventHandler.Response:
SCRIPTTEXT(Option Explicit On Option Strict On
Imports System Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports Mongoose.IDO.Protocol Imports Mongoose.Scripting Imports Mongoose.Core.Common
Namespace Mongoose.GlobalScripts Public Class EvHandler_DeptChanged_0 Inherits GlobalScript
Sub Main() Dim code As String = ThisForm.PrimaryIDOCollection.GetCurrentObjectProperty("Dept").ToString().Trim() Dim description As String = "" If code <> "" Then Dim request As New LoadCollectionRequestData() request.IDOName = "SLDepts" request.PropertyList.SetProperties("Description") request.Filter = "Dept = " & SqlLiteral.Format(code, SqlLiteralFormatFlags.UseQuotes) request.RecordCap = 1 Dim response As LoadCollectionResponseData = Me.IDOClient.LoadCollection(request) If response.Items.Count > 0 Then description = response.Items(0).PropertyValues(0).Value.ToString() End If End If ThisForm.PrimaryIDOCollection.SetCurrentObjectPropertyPlusModifyRefresh("DeptDescription", description) ReturnValue = "0" End Sub End Class End Namespace )

EventHandler.Name: InitialChangeChanged
EventHandler.Response:
SCRIPTTEXT(Option Explicit On Option Strict On
Imports System Imports Microsoft.VisualBasic Imports Mongoose.IDO.Protocol Imports Mongoose.Scripting Imports Mongoose.Core.Common
Namespace Mongoose.GlobalScripts Public Class EvHandler_InitialChangeChanged_0 Inherits GlobalScript
Sub Main() Dim change As String = ThisForm.PrimaryIDOCollection.GetCurrentObjectProperty("InitialChange").ToString().Trim() Dim flags As String = "00000" Select Case change Case "Documentation" flags = "01000" Case "Machine", "Process", "Specification", "Variance(waiver)" flags = "11011" Case "Material" flags = "11000" Case "Tooling" flags = "00001" End Select Dim props() As String = {"ReqCosting", "ReqDocumentation", "ReqMaterial", "ReqProcess", "ReqToolMachine"} For i As Integer = 0 To props.Length - 1 ThisForm.PrimaryIDOCollection.SetCurrentObjectPropertyPlusModifyRefresh(props(i), flags.Substring(i, 1)) Next ReturnValue = "0" End Sub End Class End Namespace )
